subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Cricket become popular in our country. But it has a costly game. Recently it surpasses a great appeal among the people all over the world. Its popularity be also seen playing cricket. Now rural youths that of football.
guide_solution: (a) Cricket has a great appeal among the people all over the world. (b) But it is a costly game. (c) Recently it has become popular in our country. (d) Its popularity surpasses that of football. (e) Now rural youths are also seen playing cricket.
